szenen.vo: [intense] Look at the five people you spend the most time with.
That's who you're becoming. Like it or not.
[intense] If they drain your energy... you'll end up empty.
If they push you... you'll go further than you ever thought.
[shouting] So choose your circle like your future depends on it! Because it does!
[whispers] And if that means being alone for a while? [intense] That's okay.
[shouting] Find the people who make you better. And LEVEL UP!
